narr: An upper level low and remnant MCVs produced several rounds of heavy rain and training storms that produced flash flooding for a few day across the region, mainly across Central Texas.
ev: The emergency manager reported about 3 to 4 inches of rain. In Palestine, water had been running over the road near 325 Spring Street, and cars were stalled in water near 936 W Oak.
Emergency management reported several county roads closed due to flooding and include CR 147, 120, 119, and 132.
Emergency management reported several road closures ENE of Cameron due to flooding. Impacted roads include CR 276, 140, 273, 250, 138, and 254.
Emergency management reported US-77 at Sandy Creek closed due to flooding.
Emergency management reported FM 485 and FM 979 closed due to flooding.
An EM reported CR 223, north of Cameron, was closed due to flooding.
EM reported a water rescue on CR 941 and Sneed Creek in Freestone County.
EM reported water rescue on CR 301.
EM reported a swift water rescue in a low water crossing near Indian trail and South Loop Drive southeast of McGregor.
A USAF partner relayed a picture of flood waters on Elk Road (FM 2491) east of Waco.
EM reported a swift water rescue near Waco Creek at New Road.
Cowhouse Creek at Pidcoke rose 16 feet in less than an hour.
South Nolan Creek and Twin Creek Rd rose 6.32 ft in less than 45 minutes.
EM reported FM 320 near Palestine closed due to flooding.
EM reported that both US-287 and HWY 294 near Elkhart were closed due to flooding.
EM reported FM 1817 near FM 2022 closed due to flooding and damage.
EM reported road damage on FM 315 near Elmwood due to flooding.
EM reported road washed out due to flooding at CR 2608 near Tennessee Colony.
EM reported water over the roadway at Tidwell Creek and South Main.
EM reported that the full length of Kitty Kat Lane was closed due to flooding and is impassable.
EM reported East Boone Prairie Rd at Mineral Creek impassable due to flooding.
EM reported Little Mississippi Cemetery Rd impassable due to water about 1/2 mile past the dump.
EM reported water over the roadway at 5500 S FM 46 west of Owensville.
EM reported FM 1373 at Alligator Creek flooded and impassable.
The EM reported the full length of Closs Rd, between Hammond and Calvert, was closed due to flooding.
The EM reported the full length of Yastic Rd, between Bremond and Hammond, was closed due to flooding.
EM reported water over road on N FM 46 near Liere Dairy and is washed out so impassable.
EM reported that portions of FM 2293 between Lone Wolf Road and Walnut Creek closed due to flooding.
Flash flooding was reported on Blue Flat Road just west of the Interstate 20 Santo exit.
An EM reported 6 to 8 inches of water over the roadway at the intersection of Meixner Road and FM 308 southwest of Elm Mott.
EM reported FM 1304 at HCR 2214 near Aquilla flooded and impassable.
FM 933 was flooded and closed in the 1300 block south of Aquilla.
EM reported 5 to 6 inches of water over FM 1838 south of Dawson.

EM reported two high water rescues on the service road near mile marker 220 of Interstate 45 north of Richland. The first one was at the marked start time, and the second one was about half an hour later.
EM reported a high water rescue on SW CR 2340 south of Richland.
A media partner relayed a report of road flooding at the Columbia Balloon base WNW of Palestine. That area had received 4.20 of rain at the time of the report.

Local law enforcement reported widespread flooding across Anderson County including 225 Spring St, FM 320, ACR 425, ACR 4251, ACR 422, ACR 4253, ACR 2202, ACR 370, and Salt Works Rd. Cars were still stalled in flood waters on 936 W Oak St. in Palestine as well.
EM relayed a report from a trained spotter that water was over the road on LCR 456 just west of the railroad and was potentially washed out.
